fact: On 20 January 2023 an MoU was signed transferring the DAMA electronic patient record software from CBCHS to the ministry, with CDC support since October 2020; DAMA is used at various sites as an electronic register.
title: Partenariat public-privé : Un projet de financement pour la signature du Mémorandum d'Entente entre CBCHS et le MINSANTE sur la rétrocession du logiciel DAMA.
